name: Minamoto no Kanemasa
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 78); Porter’s note gives the dates as: d. c. 1112.

poems.title: Between Awaji and the shore
poems.author: Minamoto no Kanemasa
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 78
poems.text:
Between Awaji and the shore
The birds scream in their flight;
Full oft they’ve made the Suma Guard
Toss through a sleepless night,
Until the morning light.
